title: Structural profiles of the full phagocyte NADPH oxidase unveiled by combining computational biology and experimental knowledge.
authors: Aimeur, Sana; Fas, Burcu Aykac; Serfaty, Xavier; Santuz, Hubert; Sacquin-Mora, Sophie; Bizouarn, Tania; Taly, Antoine; Baciou, Laura
one_liner_zh: 该文结合AlphaFold2建模与分子动力学模拟，解析NADPH氧化酶多亚基复合物组装，并揭示p47(phox)无序区域在远距离蛋白-蛋白及膜-蛋白互作中的关键作用，与本课题的IDR介导PPI机制建模高度契合。
abstract: The phagocyte NADPH oxidase (NOX2) is an enzyme, crucial for innate immune defense, producing reactive oxygen species necessary for pathogen destruction. Its activation requires the assembly of soluble proteins (p47(phox), p40(phox), p67(phox), and Rac) with the membrane-bound flavocytochrome b(558) (cytb(558)). We combined circular-dichroism analyses, with decades of experimental data, to filter structural models of the NADPH oxidase complex generated by the artificial intelligence program AlphaFold2 (AF2). The predicted patterns tend to closely resemble the active states of the proteins, as shown by the compact structure of the cytb(558), whose dehydrogenase domain is stabilized closer to the membrane. The modeling of the interaction of p47(phox) with cytb(558), which is the initial assembly and activation steps of the NADPH oxidase, enables us to describe how the C terminus of p47(phox) interacts with the cytb(558). Combining the AF2 cytb(558)-p47(phox) model and its classical molecular dynamics simulations, we highlighted new hydrophobic lipid insertions of p47(phox), particularly at residues Trp80-Phe81 of its PX domain. The AF2 models also revealed the implications of intrinsically disordered regions, such as the fragment between the PX domain and the SH3 regions of p47(phox), in ensuring distant protein-protein and membrane-protein interactions. Finally, the AF2 prediction of the cytb(558)-Trimera model highlighted the importance of leaving Rac1 as a separate protein to reach an active state of the NADPH oxidase complex. Altogether, our step-by-step approach provides a structural model of the active complex showing how disordered regions and specific lipid and protein interactions can enable and stabilize the multisubunit assembly.
abstract_zh: 吞噬细胞NADPH氧化酶（NOX2）是一种酶，对先天免疫防御至关重要，产生活性氧以消灭病原体。其激活需要可溶性蛋白（p47(phox)、p40(phox)、p67(phox)和Rac）与膜结合型细胞色素b(558)（cytb(558)）组装。我们将圆二色性分析与数十年的实验数据相结合，以筛选由人工智能程序AlphaFold2（AF2）生成的NADPH氧化酶复合物结构模型。预测模式往往与蛋白质的活性状态高度相似，如cytb(558)的紧凑结构所示，其脱氢酶结构域稳定地靠近膜。对p47(phox)与cytb(558)相互作用的建模，这是NADPH氧化酶初始组装和激活步骤，使我们能够描述p47(phox)的C端如何与cytb(558)相互作用。结合AF2 cytb(558)-p47(phox)模型及其经典分子动力学模拟，我们突出了p47(phox)新的疏水性脂质插入，特别是在其PX结构域的Trp80-Phe81残基处。AF2模型还揭示了内在无序区域的作用，如p47(phox)的PX结构域与SH3区域之间的片段，在确保远距离蛋白-蛋白和膜-蛋白相互作用中的意义。最后，AF2对cytb(558)-Trimera模型的预测强调了将Rac1作为独立蛋白保留以达到NADPH氧化酶复合物活性状态的重要性。总体而言，我们的逐步方法提供了活性复合物的结构模型，展示了无序区域及特定脂质和蛋白相互作用如何促成并稳定多亚基组装。
